rows.description: This GitHub repo is a powerhouse collection of APIs you can start using immediately to build everything from simple automations to full-scale applications. One of the most valuable API lists on GitHub—period. 💪

Google Maps Scraper & Lead Generation Tool. Extract 50+ data points including business emails, phone numbers, and social profiles. Includes enrichment features, API access, and a generous free plan with 200 searches/month.
Open-source AI agent for B2B lead generation — describe your product, it finds the people who fit, explains why each one does, and emails them from your mailbox. Self-hosted CLI, one install.

Free, open-source Google Maps scraper for lead generation (Python, no API key, no Docker). Exports name, phone, email, website, rating and Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn/TikTok/YouTube/X links to CSV. 100 places with emails in 44 s; --grid beats Google's 120 cap. MX email check, ad-pixel detection. Skill for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
